data.question_title: The sum of the coefficients of even power of x in the expansion of \(\left( 1 + x + x ^ { 2 } + x ^ { 3 } \right) ^ { 5 }\) is:
data.explanation_txt:
To find sum of coefiicients, put \(x=1\). And since the sum of odd and even coefficeints are equal, the required answer is:

\( \cfrac{4^5}{2} = 512 \)

OR

\( 1 + x + x^2 + x^3 = (1+x)(1+x^2) \)

So, \( \left( 1 + x + x ^ { 2 } + x ^ { 3 } \right) ^ { 5 } = (1+x)^5 (1+x^2)^5 \)

Upon expansion, \( (1+5x + 10x^2 + 10x^3 + 5x^4 + x^5)(1 + 5 x ^ { 2 } + 10 x ^ { 4 } + 10 x ^ { 6 } + 5 x ^ { 8 } + x ^ { 10 } ) \)

The even powers occur if the terms of second bracket are multiplied by terms with even power of \(x\) in first bracket. Also the sum of coeffieicients in second bracket is \(2^5 = 32 \)

And hence the final answer is \( 32 + 10 \times 32 + 5 \times 32 = 512 \)

To find sum of coefiicients, put \(x=1\). And since the sum of odd and even coefficeints are equal, the required answer is:

\( \cfrac{4^5}{2} = 512 \)

OR

\( 1 + x + x^2 + x^3 = (1+x)(1+x^2) \)

So, \( \left( 1 + x + x ^ { 2 } + x ^ { 3 } \right) ^ { 5 } = (1+x)^5 (1+x^2)^5 \)

Upon expansion, \( (1+5x + 10x^2 + 10x^3 + 5x^4 + x^5)(1 + 5 x ^ { 2 } + 10 x ^ { 4 } + 10 x ^ { 6 } + 5 x ^ { 8 } + x ^ { 10 } ) \)

The even powers occur if the terms of second bracket are multiplied by terms with even power of \(x\) in first bracket. Also the sum of coeffieicients in second bracket is \(2^5 = 32 \)

And hence the final answer is \( 32 + 10 \times 32 + 5 \times 32 = 512 \)

\(2-x=\cfrac{0.8}{2} = 0.4 \\ \Rightarrow x = 1.6\)

So,

\(\begin{align} K_c & = \cfrac{[PCl_3][Cl_2]}{[PCl_5]} \\ & = \cfrac{0.4 \times 0.4}{1.6} \\ & = 0.1 \end{align}\)
